reviews.x: I read about these for months, all the while thinking how awfully tangled they would get in my curly hair. Finally took the plunge and have been pleasantly surprised. In all this time, I have only used one. I use it to pineapple overnight, and to put my hair up when I don’t feel like messing with it. Definitely have to pull it open and carefully remove from my hair. Regardless, it is a GO TO for my curly hair routine.

I love invisibobble hair ties. They don't dent your hair as bad, they don't get tangled, and they don't cause headaches from hair pulled back too right. That being said, when I first recieved them, I was very surprised by how tiny the hair ties were. They were about an inch in diameter! But, it didn't end up being a problem as they stretched to fit and have now lost some elasticity. I would buy them again, but they aren't miraculous. Also, the price is definitely high for three tiny hair bands.

I know several people who use them for ponytail holders as well, but unfortunately my hair is to thin for that. Great product, always returns to its usual form, no stretching and no hair damage.

reviews.t: Holds ANY Type of Hair without Marks!
reviews.x: I love these hair ties. They hold my fine hair as well as they hold my sister's long thick wavy hair. I gave them to  all my "gal pals" and co-workers as stocking stuffers. There are others out there, but these always go back into shape and last a very,very long time. And best of all, they don't leeaave any dents or marks in your hair!  A win-win to me!

Seriously save my hair...They dont crease or pull my hair at all AND they stay where I put them lol I have super thick hair and it is bleached. If I don't have one of these I won't put my hair up. Period. They are a life saver for sure! I will say that I might try the MEGA because my hair is so thick and heavy, but these do the job until I decide to!

I LOVE THESE. I'm slightly annoyed they live up to the hype XD They do get tangled a bit in my hair, but I have curly hair, so EVERYTHING gets tangled. These stay where I put them and don't slide around or drag down during the day. I can use one of these to hold my hair in a bun all day - it usually takes 2-3 regular elastics to keep the weight up.

claims.text: Many reviewers find these hair ties hold hair well, stay in place, and don't dent, tangle, or pull hair.
Several reviewers were surprised that the hair ties are very small.
Some reviewers report receiving fewer hair ties than the listing advertised.
A few reviewers say the ties stretch out or break easily, though some note they can be restored with hot water.
Some reviewers with long, thick, or wavy hair found the ties uncomfortable, hard to remove, or unsuitable.
